notes.title: Achievements patch
notes.content:
Hi all!

A patch has just been released that fixed achievements not unlocking on Linux and MacOS. After updating, you should be able to just run the game to claim your achievements. If that doesn't work, try completing Level 1 again.

Please don't hesitate to reach out or post in the forums with issues you encounter.

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: The Sword Slinger demo has been updated!
notes.content:
The demo has once again been updated! Here are the update notes:
- One additional action and one additional trigger are available in the demo
- Music has been updated
- Environment art has been added to liven things up

As always, please feel free to send me your feedback admin@firebelley.com or send me a DM on Twitter @firebelley.

I hope you enjoy!
